title: Draft: isolated visual research map for Holovator photo leads
consolidation_note: Historical unlinked 16-marker Holovator/one-ladder research previews superseded by #77 onward. Keep approximate registration/provenance; do not resurrect obsolete13/15/16-marker display or strict23-device gate as current all-project blocker.
original_pr_description:
## Isolated Holovator visual prototype — NOT a production map release

The owner asked for the lift locations to become **visual**, not remain only in JSON. This draft PR adds **one unlinked, independent, read-only HTML research preview**, `holovator-research-preview.html`, to the existing independent Edition B repository. It reuses **the existing unchanged** `maps/lumiose-game-map.jpg`, does not modify `maps.html`/`maps.js`/`maps.css` or `sector-maps.html` and does not alter the original ChatGPT Site.

### What is visual
- Thirteen **approximate yellow double-chevron** markers, with tap/click to show source context and unverified entrance/roof details.
- Filtering for mission-linked vs other photo leads, text search, accessible list and map buttons, 720px-minimum scrollable map for mobile.
- Two independent newly calibrated Estival Avenue symbol centres: Café Gallant ≈**(578,1025)** and Espace Vide/Bleu Sector 4 ≈**(477,1130)** in existing 1920px source image, from two separate four-Wild-Zone-control photo alignments. Original private gameplay photos are **not** included.
- The other 11 photo-derived, provisional area markers are sourced from unmerged research PR #58. Added research-only Mission #4 Rouge Plaza candidate (W06/W07 repeat symbol), Jaune Sector 4 (W06/W07 repeat but manual Atlas projection inconsistent by ~50px), and Mission #92 Bleu Sector 8/Café Soleil (W10 single view). **Mission #56 and #61 remain unpinned; none of the 13 is a confirmed physical entrance.**

### Critical release hold
This is an **unlinked preview page on an unmerged draft PR**, not a replacement of production maps or one of the 23 individually confirmed Holovators. All thirteen displayed positions are **approximate owner-photo map symbols, not certified physical street entrances**. **0/23 unique device-category IDs** have been extracted from the public interactive sources; floors, rooftop destinations and exact entrance points remain unproven. Continue research, independently match 23/23 first, then approve a *separate* tested Holovator-only production layer; scaffolds and ladders afterwards.

No HTML/JS/CSS of existing routes, Wild Zone pins, source map binary, original Site A, `main`, Supabase, user saves, ratings, feedback or checklist records touched. No publication, deployment or merge has been authorized by creating this draft.

Related: [research PR #58](https://github.com/trevieisking/lumiose-atlas-pokemon-za/pull/58) and [tracker #28](https://github.com/trevieisking/lumiose-atlas-pokemon-za/issues/28).

**Remaining QA:** render and test this specific GitHub draft page against the unchanged original 1920px city JPG on desktop and phone; independently match all 23 external Holovator-category devices and ground/roof pairs; complete release checks. Do not promote until the 23/23 device gate holds.

### New owner screenshot evidence and visual QA — batch 11

- **W06/W07** photographs contain the same distinct yellow symbols at WZ3/Rouge Plaza (mission #004 vicinity), Hibernal Avenue (mission #080 vicinity), and Jaune Sector 4 east of Académie Étoile. Three icon pairs plus WZ3 badge centre agree on camera pan (+615.75,+104.75) at **2.09px RMS**; this is photo-icon identity, not source-map georeferencing accuracy.
- **W10** shows a one-photo yellow symbol at (63,453), approx source-JPG (352,1496) near Café Soleil/Bleu Sector 8 and mission #092. No independent proof it is Aimant's actual lift.
- A [full evidence JSON](https://github.com/trevieisking/lumiose-atlas-pokemon-za/blob/docs/holovator-source-markers-sector-audit-20261121/MAPS_W06_W07_HOLOVATOR_MATCHES_2026-11-22.json) and plan batch 11 reside in docs-only PR #58, not copied into the runtime preview branch.
- **Actual desktop/mobile Chromium interaction QA** completed on a **separate private offline five-photo HTML** built from the owner's W06/W07/W08/W09/W10 uploaded photos: full images loaded, five tabs and on-map buttons worked, selected detail worked, repeated/single-photo filter worked, zero JS errors at **1365×905** and **390×844**. The **GitHub single-file preview itself** passed V8 inline JS syntax and static 13-location in-bounds/no-network/no-storage checks; this is **not a claim of browser-rendered QA against the original city JPG**. Private owner images are NOT committed to this repository.
- Independent [player-made all-Holovator/ladders field map](https://forum.gamer.com.tw/C.php?bsn=1647&snA=127600) identifies **nine initially broken units** that are repaired through side missions and notes that discovered/inspected Holovators appear on the player's in-game map, broken units gray. Its authored map image is **not copied** into this PR.

**Do not merge or deploy** this research-only draft before the 23 physical device matching and full production map QA/owner-imposed completion gates; no scaffolds or item pins.

### Owner photo comparison V3 (private, ten images) — independent of this draft

Research PR #58 now includes [batch 12 all-ten original owner photo audit](https://github.com/trevieisking/lumiose-atlas-pokemon-za/blob/docs/holovator-source-markers-sector-audit-20261121/MAPS_ALL_TEN_OWNER_HOLOVATOR_VISUAL_AUDIT_2026-11-22.json) with **16 photographed candidate groups (12 repeated) and 28 photo observations**. A **new private conversation-only HTML comparison viewer** shows all ten original user images, with mobile/desktop Chromium Playwright interaction QA (10 tabs, images loaded, tap-to-inspect and repeat/single filters, 0 JS errors). **No original user image binary appears in this GitHub draft or public repository**.

This **PR #59 remains an unmerged, unlinked single-file prototype** with **15 provisional yellow *map-symbol* positions** on the unchanged city JPG. It is **not a completed 23-Holovator release**. The northern W06/W07 arrow east of Sushi High Roller has a *potential, unproven* connection to #080 near Café Kizuna; two separate icons in that road corridor must not be merged without actual entrance/roof evidence. Source reported category 23 still needs individual IDs and exact physical device verification. Scaffolds/ladders are a later phase.

## Vert Plaza corrected from owner north-up closeups — latest 15 research markers

Three additional, original owner north-locked game-map photographs (private `1000027221.heic`, `1000027222.heic`, `1000027220.heic`) demonstrate **FOUR distinct yellow double-up-chevron Holovator *map symbols*** around green **Vert Plaza/Wild Zone 2**, **not inside it**: (i) east edge of Vert Sector 4, (ii) middle/lower Vert Sector 4 beside Café Classe, (iii) farther south by Vert Pokémon Center, (iv) east of Vert Plaza by Café Cyclone/Coulant Waterway. **Black round yellow-diamond and magenta-triangle icons around the green plaza are not Holovators.**

On the unchanged original 1920px city JPG, screenshot-to-map geometric fitting gives **approximate research symbol positions**: `r-vert4-east=(1055,1383)`, `r-classe=(1010,1420)`, `r-vert4-south=(943,1466)`, `r-cyclone=(1299,1337)`. **Do not call these verified physical ground door coordinates or roof exits**. The southern marker is the previously documented W04 yellow icon `WIDE-C13`; old `r-classe` ≈(948,1470) was that *third southern icon*, not a mislocated instance of the middle Café Classe symbol. We preserved its research identity separately while correcting the original wrong grouping.

New photographic evidence [research PR #58, batch 13](https://github.com/trevieisking/lumiose-atlas-pokemon-za/pull/58): [direct source coordinate record](https://github.com/trevieisking/lumiose-atlas-pokemon-za/blob/docs/holovator-source-markers-sector-audit-20261121/MAPS_VERT_PLAZA_CLOSEUP_LIFT_CORRECTION_2026-11-22.json), manifest rev 15, ledger AT-252. VP-C→VP-A matched 137 features with 1.34px photo reprojection RMS; VP-C→VP-B 187 features with 1.18px; original W04 six-landmark city registration RMS 5.8px. **These measure photographed map symbol agreement, not real-game roof/entrance precision.**

Separate private **13-photo, 18 candidate-group** offline HTML comparison V4 was tested with Chromium/Playwright at desktop (1365×905) and mobile-sized (390×844), VP-A 3 / VP-B 1 / VP-C 4 visible chevrons, tap-to-inspect and repeat filter working, zero JS errors. **That QA is not direct CI or preview-web-hosted pixel QA of this GitHub draft**. No owner screenshot binary published to GitHub. This PR changes only the already isolated single HTML preview; **still DRAFT / unmerged / unlinked / no live map update**. 23 unique physical category device IDs and entry/roof pairs remain unverified; scaffold phase deferred.


## L001 Hotel Z — separate first ladder research visual

**User-sourced field photography:** a real metal wall ladder in a narrow enclosed courtyard immediately to the **RIGHT when standing outside and facing the Hotel Z entrance**, Vert Sector 8. Red map ring is the player's standing position, blue arrow is facing direction. We have two red-ring map frames and a physical ladder photo. A SIFT/RANSAC image alignment against the unchanged original 1920px map projects the standing point at **approx (1202,1556)**, not a one-pixel-certified door. Exact roof arrival and any second ladder remain unknown. See [source-backed L001 survey](https://github.com/trevieisking/lumiose-atlas-pokemon-za/blob/docs/holovator-source-markers-sector-audit-20261121/MAPS_LADDER_FIELD_SURVEY_2026-11-22.json).

The **new separate, unlinked, read-only `ladder-research-preview.html`** visual layer uses existing `maps/lumiose-game-map.jpg` with exactly **one** colored ladder research symbol (different from 15 amber Holovators). `holovator-research-preview.html` now links to L001 and corrects owner-provided icon meanings: yellow double-up chevrons Holovators, red Poké Ball circles Pokémon Centers, red ring player current location, blue arrow facing direction, gold/pink dark round markers Hyperspace DLC. **No original user photo bytes, Supabase, persistence, progress writes, existing production map file edits, or third-party artwork** in PR. Separate private local three-photo tab viewer was tested desktop/mobile sized with zero JS errors; hosted preview and Android actual-device QA not yet claimed.

**Remain DRAFT and unmerged**: owner still wants completion of all Holovators before safe production lift map release, with ladder entries now separately gathered one at a time and scaffolds deferred.


## New r-061: owner-photographed physical ground lift at approximate (765,1396)

The owner provided direct photo evidence of the **golden physical Holovator** and their red-ring north-up map position in two zoom settings, in **Bleu Sector 3 just southeast of Bleu Plaza / northwest of Aymlis Park (WZ12), beside the short southwest corner of the Sector 3 building**. Original 1536×865 screenshots `1000027232.heic`, `1000027233.heic`, `1000027234.heic`, `1000027235.heic` were aligned privately and never committed to GitHub. Approx original `maps/lumiose-game-map.jpg` source image point **(765,1396)**, from two independently registered older owner photo controls giving (762.29,1395.74) and (769.07,1396.90). This is a photo-supported street entry **area**, not subpixel door-base or verified roof exit. See [full research source record](https://github.com/trevieisking/lumiose-atlas-pokemon-za/blob/docs/holovator-source-markers-sector-audit-20261121/MAPS_HOLOVATOR_061_OWNER_ENTRY_SURVEY_2026-11-22.json).

**This unmerged draft preview now has 16 research markers**, including `r-061` (mission 61), with a **solid amber/teal ring** for an owner-photographed ground device vs **15 dashed approximate photo-symbol leads**. Same original unchanged guide 1920px city map JPEG. New card contains directions, mission context, source-image controls and roof uncertainty. Existing 15 markers, Hotel Z Ladder L001 page, production `maps.html`, live site code, GitHub main, player saves, feedback, ratings and Supabase **not touched**. Static V8 compile, all 16 coordinates bounded, unique IDs/no network calls checked. Private owner-only four-photo HTML viewer passed real desktop/mobile-sized Chromium tests; the hosted GitHub draft with original city image still needs its own browser QA before any eventual live release.

**External physical 23-category marker ID match and rooftop landing still unknown.** Keep draft/unmerged pending complete 23-device + ground/roof release gate, scaffolds separately later.

## Mission #061 fifth owner photo adds rooftop scene, not a new map pin — AT-256

The owner added original **fifth photo `1000027236.heic`** showing their character on a luminous rooftop arrival pad immediately after reporting the #061 Holovator journey. **Prism Tower** is visible to the right and a park/fountain below left; a separate **Investigate** prompt is present near a nearby object. This **visually documents the upper rooftop arrival scene** but does not contain a large north-up city map with a roof-position red ring. It cannot justify an exact native-city-JPG roof X/Y or height. User reports route continuity from the previously photographed **ground lift in Bleu Sector 3**.

The existing `r-061` marker remains **one owner-ground-physical-photo-supported research pin at approx (765,1396)**. Its evidence/details now mention **five** owner photos and the upper scene; its missing-evidence field states roof full-map coordinate and external Holovator category device ID **unverified**. **16** research markers retained, **0 new roof pins**, unchanged original city JPEG and live guide. See [five-photo survey](https://github.com/trevieisking/lumiose-atlas-pokemon-za/blob/docs/holovator-source-markers-sector-audit-20261121/MAPS_HOLOVATOR_061_OWNER_ENTRY_SURVEY_2026-11-22.json), master plan batch17, manifest rev19, AT-256.

Private five-photo viewer remains **conversation-only** and was Chromium tested at desktop and phone-size viewports, five tabs, decoded fifth image and zero JS page errors. Neither public source repo nor this PR includes the original user photo bytes. **Draft/unmerged; not released**.
